cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. For tonight's courtyard film, you fold the moon; I'll switch off the lamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I fold the moon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Start with the crescent. It already has a crease.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the lamps. You handle the sky.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do lamps, chairs and projector if you'll own the moon. Can I tell the audience we're waiting for your blackout?

mechanism: A teaches a helper an impossible blackout method while refusing to take that task back in an otherwise negotiable division of labor.
confusable: Approving an impossible plan is D148; here B must personally accept the impossible part as their responsibility.
comparison: Event labor negotiation differs from recovering a lost hour while A reserves labeling work.
seedUse: Keep moon folding and offered workload swap; make the professional correct the helper's actual proposed division.
